mentions.name: Mimesis Protocol
mentions.description: This project defines a structured semantic representation model for natural language that captures an utterance as a structured object with separate layers: core (semantic meaning and emotion), will (communicative purpose and influence), flow (discourse framing/progression), and exp (surface realization). It ships with an English/Korean whitepaper, a schema spec, and a working interactive demo, and is being explored as an intermediate representation layer for LLM systems, agent workflows, and discourse analysis.
mentions.problem: Utterances often have a gap between their surface form and their actual function in context — e.g., "Do you know what time it is?" may look like a question but pragmatically function as criticism, pressure, or a prompt for reflection.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on a project called *Mimesis Protocol* — a structured semantic representation model for natural language.
